plan: Since this functions as a second-price auction (the clock ends when the second-highest bidder exits, and the winner pays the losing bidder's bid), the dominant strategy is to bid exactly my true value. Bidding higher risks paying more than the item is worth if I win; bidding lower risks losing profitable auctions. Bidding my true value of $31 maximizes expected profit regardless of others' strategies.
